deckTitle: Pathology & Forensic Medicine: The Post-Mortem Posture

cards.power: The Programmed Suicide. Arnie shrinks and packs his bags without waking the Immune Police.
cards.lore: Follows orders(BCL-2/P53). The Quiet Sacrifice — preventing viral punks or cancerous revolts.
cards.gradeReason: Shrinks, packs bags, exits without drama. The quietest wrestling move on the cards.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: noir cartoon. Subject: tiny badger packing suitcase, body shrinking neatly. Mood: resigned dignity.

cards.power: The Toxic Explosion. Splits DAMP-Guns everywhere.
cards.lore: Result of Ischemia/toxins. Triggers a Neutrophil-Riot (causing secondary neighbor damage).
cards.gradeReason: Explodes DAMP-guns everywhere. Maximum chaos, zero etiquette. Pure necrotic spectacle.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: punk explosion cartoon. Subject: frog detonating in green inflammatory chaos. Mood: chaotic, messy.

cards.power: The Size-Reduction. Gets smaller to survive a Famine-Match.
cards.lore: Digests his own organelles to save metabolic rent. Efficient but weak.
cards.gradeReason: Size-reduction play is clear but passive — Artie survives by doing less, not more.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: wiry survival cartoon. Subject: withered figure digesting own furniture to stay alive. Mood: stoic.

cards.power: The Tissue-Swap. Replaces a sensitive wall with tough armor to survive chronic irritation.
cards.lore: A defensive move, but a Pre-Cancer-Risk that can evolve into Malignant-Mel.
cards.gradeReason: Shape-shift from soft to armored. Defensive wrestler with a lethal pre-cancer twist.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: transformation comics. Subject: chameleon shedding delicate skin for thick battle-armor. Mood: adaptive threat.

cards.power: The Kamikaze Attack. Arrives first to spray Oxygen-Bleach (Free Radicals).
cards.lore: Short-lived. Dies in the trenches, forming the Pus-Puddle of acute inflammation.
cards.gradeReason: First in, dies in the trenches. Kamikaze bleach-sprayer, every time.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: kamikaze warrior cartoon. Subject: segmented-nucleus soldier spraying bleach, burning out fast. Mood: fierce sacrifice.

cards.power: The Garbage-Eater. Cleans Nathan's mess and decides if it's time for Building-Henry.
cards.lore: The Director who presents the enemy's head to the T-Cell-Tacticians.
cards.gradeReason: Garbage-eater director role needs Nathan and Henry as context to fully land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: cleanup crew cartoon. Subject: hippo in hazmat suit devouring cellular debris. Mood: efficient authority.

cards.power: The Eternal Prison. Builds a wall when Stubborn-Strep or Tuberculo-Tot can't be killed.
cards.lore: Type IV hypersensitivity — the wall breaks via immunosuppression, prisoners escape.
cards.gradeReason: Walls the prisoner forever. The Eternal Prison is instantly playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: castle siege cartoon. Subject: turtle constructing fortress ring around a prisoner. Mood: eternal standoff.

cards.power: The Permanent Patch. Fills holes with Biological-Cement (Scar tissue).
cards.lore: Provides strength but loses function — heart patched by Fiona won't pump.
cards.gradeReason: Patches wounds in cement. Tragic cardiac result needs physiological context to land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: construction cartoon. Subject: cat cementing over a beating heart, sealing it shut. Mood: dutiful tragedy.

cards.power: The Slow-Growing. Just wants to grow in his own little bubble.
cards.lore: Only danger is Pressure (e.g., in the Brain-Bunker where space is limited).
cards.gradeReason: Slow bubble-grower, harmless unless cornered. Passive character, pressure is the only move.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: cozy cartoon. Subject: puffer fish content in glass bowl, growing slowly. Mood: harmless but crowded.

cards.power: The Border-Breacher. Doesn't respect the Basement Membrane.
cards.lore: Cuts through walls and hitchhikes on the Lymph-Highway to reach distant lands.
cards.gradeReason: Breaks basement membranes, hitchhikes on lymph. Border-Breacher is pure invasion energy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: invasion cartoon. Subject: octopus punching through basement membrane wall. Mood: aggressive expansion.

cards.power: The Global Colonialist. Sets up Sub-Malitias in distant organs.
cards.lore: Stage IV war. Once Mitch colonizes, the Stain-Brigade rarely wins alone.
cards.gradeReason: Global Colonialist planting Sub-Malitias in distant organs. Stage IV wrestling, peak theater.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: colonial map cartoon. Subject: rat planting flags across organ territories. Mood: unstoppable conquest.

cards.power: The DNA-Police. Checks blueprints for errors and calls Apoptosis-Arnie to end mutated cells.
cards.lore: If Peter is deleted (Li-Fraumeni), the Anaplasia-Assassins go completely unchecked.
cards.gradeReason: DNA-Police calls Arnie when blueprints fail. Clear guardian character, immediately playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: detective cartoon. Subject: owl judge reviewing DNA blueprints with gavel raised. Mood: stern justice.

cards.power: The Gravity-Stain. Shows where blood settled after the Heart-Pump stopped.
cards.lore: If Livor is on the back but the body is face-down, the Scene-Scenery was tampered with.
cards.gradeReason: Gravity-Stain reveals the story — but performance is diagnostic, not embodied.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: forensic noir. Subject: purple stain shadow outlining body position and tampering clue. Mood: eerie revelation.

cards.power: The Muscle-Lock. ATP-Batteries run out, and Calcium-Gates leak.
cards.lore: The Corpse-Handcuff that starts at the jaw and moves down.
cards.gradeReason: Muscle-Lock from jaw downward. Clear character but mechanistic framing dominates.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: stiff comedy cartoon. Subject: goat locked rigid mid-leap, jaw clenched first. Mood: grotesque rigor.

cards.power: The Thermal-Drop. Cools the body to match the Arena-Temperature.
cards.lore: Used via the Henssge-Nomogram to build a Time-Since-Death clock.
cards.gradeReason: Thermal-Drop matches arena temperature. A slow clock, not a performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: clinical cartoon. Subject: thermometer sinking into icy forensic landscape. Mood: methodical chill.

cards.power: The Gas-Factory. Uses Internal-Bacteria-Punks to digest from the inside out.
cards.lore: The natural Cleanup-Crew that turns the body green and distended.
cards.gradeReason: Gas-Factory cooks you from inside. Green, bloated, revolting spectacle. Instantly playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: horror comedy. Subject: green bloated raccoon surrounded by gas bubbles, marbling skin. Mood: grotesque decay.

cards.power: The Friction-Sign. Shows the direction of the Slide from a Scrape-Match.
cards.lore: Yellow/dry = happened after the bell. Red/crusty = happened during the fight.
cards.gradeReason: Friction-Sign reads slide direction. Forensic evidence marker, less a performer.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: forensic cartoon. Subject: rhinoceros with directional scrape arrows on hide. Mood: evidence trail.

cards.power: The Inner-Leak. A Hemorrhage-in-Hiding. Skin intact, but pipes broken underneath.
cards.lore: Follows the Heme-Breakdown-Road (Hemoglobin → Biliverdin → Bilirubin).
cards.gradeReason: Inner-Leak hiding under skin. Color timeline lore is rich; power is modest.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: color-map cartoon. Subject: chameleon bruise cycling red-blue-green-yellow beneath intact skin. Mood: hidden damage.

cards.power: The Blunt-Force-Rip. Caused by crushing, leaving messy bridges behind.
cards.lore: Hallmark of the Hammer or Fist (unlike an Incised clean cut).
cards.gradeReason: Blunt-Force-Rip with tissue bridges. Vivid but the not-a-cut distinction needs explaining.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: blunt force cartoon. Subject: crocodile tearing irregular wound, tissue bridges dangling. Mood: crushing impact.

cards.power: The Kinetic-Tunnel. Entrance-Gate is neat; Exit-Gate is a chaotic mess.
cards.lore: Contact-Range shots leave a Muzzle-Stamp or Soot-Shadow on the skin.
cards.gradeReason: Neat entrance, chaotic exit. The tunnel contrast makes Bill instantly theatrical.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: ballistics cartoon. Subject: bullet entering tidy hole, exploding out ragged chaos. Mood: kinetic violence.

cards.power: The Gravity-Choke. Uses body weight to shut the Oxygen-Highway and Carotid-Pipes.
cards.lore: Death is usually from Brain-Ischemia, not a broken neck.
cards.gradeReason: Gravity-Choke with V-mark and pale furrow. Classic forensic showdown character.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: forensic giraffe cartoon. Subject: V-shaped ligature mark on tall neck, pale furrow. Mood: solemn gravity.

cards.power: The Hands-on-Halt. A Closer-Combat move.
cards.lore: Causes Tardieu-Spots (petechiae) as veins are blocked but arteries keep pumping.
cards.gradeReason: Hands-on closer-combat with Tardieu-Spots. Intense, specific, immediately performative.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: forensic swan cartoon. Subject: fingernail scratches and petechial eyes on strangled swan. Mood: intimate violence.

cards.power: The Fluid-Invasion. Fills the lungs with Arena-Water.
cards.lore: Diatoms (algae) deep in the bone marrow prove the wrestler was breathing water before dying.
cards.gradeReason: Fluid-Invasion proven by bone-marrow diatoms. Deeply theatrical forensic character.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: waterlogged cartoon. Subject: seal with foam mushroom at mouth, lungs flooded. Mood: tragic invasion.

cards.power: The Mitochondrial-Jam. Stops Cellular-Engines from using oxygen; blood stays red because cells can't eat it.
cards.lore: Kills the Electron-Transport-Chain. The victim suffocates despite O2-rich blood.
cards.gradeReason: Kills engines; victim has oxygen but can't eat it. Brilliant paradox, instantly dramatic.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: toxic paradox cartoon. Subject: pink flamingo suffocating despite oxygen-rich red blood. Mood: deadly irony.

cards.power: The Backflow-Stain. Happens when Cardio-Carl fails and blood backs up into the Liver-sponge.
cards.lore: Central-Veins flood with red while edges turn tan.
cards.gradeReason: Backflow-Stain from Cardio-Carl's failure. Needs prior context about heart failure to land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: liver pathology cartoon. Subject: dachshund with red-tan nutmeg-pattern congested liver. Mood: backed-up flow.

cards.power: The Protein-Clog. Amyloid-Alice deposits Sticky-Goo in the spleen.
cards.lore: Misfolded proteins that body can't clear turn the organs into Stiff-Statues.
cards.gradeReason: Sticky-Goo deposits stiffen organs. Amyloid character reads more as sign than performer.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: crystal microscopy cartoon. Subject: porcupine spleen glowing apple-green under Congo Red stain. Mood: stiff.

cards.power: The Rough-Surface. Coats the heart in Fibrin-Glue.
cards.lore: The inflammation makes the heart scratch against its housing (friction rub).
cards.gradeReason: Fibrin-Glue makes heart scratch housing. Friction rub needs auscultation context to perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: pericarditis cartoon. Subject: sheep heart coated in fibrin butter, scratching its pericardial housing. Mood: rough.

cards.power: The Kidney-Contractor. Turns the kidney into a Micro-Lump after too many UTI-Uprisings.
cards.lore: Renal-Pipes block with pink goo, appearing like Thyroid-Tissue under the scope.
cards.gradeReason: Kidney shrinks after UTI-uprisings. Thyroidization detail is good; character is moderate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: kidney pathology cartoon. Subject: tiny sphynx cat with scarred bumpy shrunken kidneys. Mood: chronic.

cards.power: The Global Shutdown. Occurs when Total-Pressure fails and all organs starve.
cards.lore: The Death-Spiral. If Lungs (ARDS) and Kidneys (ATN) fail, the match is lost.
cards.gradeReason: Global Shutdown when all organs starve. Powerful concept but somewhat abstract to perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: multi-organ failure cartoon. Subject: chihuahua with failing lungs and kidneys collapsing. Mood: systemic crisis.

cards.power: The Toe-Torture. Drops Uric-Acid-Needles into Joints, joining an Inflammation-Riot.
cards.lore: Loves the Big-Toe-Ring. Podagral. Rich Purine snacks are his fuel.
cards.gradeReason: Uric-Acid-Needles into the big-toe ring. Purine snack lover. Instantly painful spectacle.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: crystal agony cartoon. Subject: elephant with uric acid needles erupting from toe joint. Mood: excruciating.

cards.power: The Self-Sabotage. Her immune-army gets confused and attacks the Kidney-Filters and Skin-Shield.
cards.lore: A Type III hypersensitivity Immune-Complex war.
cards.gradeReason: Self-attacking immune army at the Kidney-Filter. Tragic autoimmune theater, instantly clear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: autoimmune drama cartoon. Subject: wolf in red mask attacking her own kidneys. Mood: tragic self-sabotage.

cards.power: The Mystery-Lump. Builds Granuloma-Gerry's everywhere, but crucially without the Caseous-Center.
cards.lore: A mysterious immune-revolt that loves to hide in the Lung-Gates.
cards.gradeReason: Mystery-Lump builds non-caseating granulomas. Depends on knowing Gerry for full impact.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: mystery granuloma cartoon. Subject: ring-tailed lemur surrounded by non-caseating nodule clusters. Mood: enigmatic.

cards.power: The Pipe-Narrower. Builds Gunk-Walls inside arteries, slowing Oxygen-Traffic.
cards.lore: If Al's wall pops, he triggers the Clot-Monster for a Heart-Halt.
cards.gradeReason: Gunk-Wall builder in arteries — triggers Clot-Monster on rupture. Gradual, structural G2.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: plaque buildup cartoon. Subject: snake coiling inside artery wall, calcifying layers. Mood: gradual obstruction.

cards.power: The Weak-Wall-Balloon. Stretches the Pipe-Armor until it bursts.
cards.lore: A Berry-Burst causes a sudden Thunderclap-Headache.
cards.gradeReason: Weak-Wall-Balloon stretching to bursting. Thunderclap-Headache punchline is G1 perfection.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: tension cartoon. Subject: puffer fish balloon stretching artery wall to near-rupture. Mood: inevitable burst.

cards.power: The Static-Stoppage. Builds a Blood-Dam that halts flow completely.
cards.lore: Born in a moving stream = Lines of Zahn. Born after death = Currant-Jelly.
cards.gradeReason: Blood-Dam builder with Lines of Zahn. Static stoppage — instantly playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dam-builder cartoon. Subject: beaver stacking fibrin Lines-of-Zahn across blood vessel. Mood: static blockade.

cards.power: The Long-Distance Strike. A piece of Thrombus that breaks free to jam a Smaller-Pipe.
cards.lore: A Saddle-Embolus blocks the main Lung-Highway, ending the match instantly.
cards.gradeReason: Breaks free from Thrombos, jams distant pipe. Saddle-Embolus is fatal theater.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: drifter cartoon. Subject: tumbleweed clot breaking loose, jamming pulmonary artery. Mood: catastrophic journey.

cards.power: The Wall-Dissolver. Eats the Alveolar-Balloons into useless, flabby Air-Sacs.
cards.lore: Loss of Snap (Elasticity). Can get air in, but can't get it out (Pink-Puffer).
cards.gradeReason: Wall-Dissolver makes floppy air-traps. Pink-Puffer concept needs elasticity explanation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: emphysema cartoon. Subject: fat frog bloated with trapped air, unable to exhale. Mood: breathless trap.

cards.power: The Mucus-Flood. Fills Airway-Tunnels with blue sludge.
cards.lore: Chronic irritation leads to Gland-Expansion, the king of the Smoker's Cough.
cards.gradeReason: Mucus-Flood Blue Bloater fills tunnels with sludge. Name says it all, instantly playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: blue bloater cartoon. Subject: blue bulldog drowning airway in thick mucus sludge. Mood: chronic congestion.

cards.power: The Liquid-Lung. Fills the Air-Balloons with pus/blood until the lung is Solid like a liver.
cards.lore: Gray Hepatization: RBCs die but the fibrin-armor stays, permanently stealing the Air-Space.
cards.gradeReason: Lung-Solidifier makes liver-like tissue. Hepatization imagery is vivid and graspable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: consolidation cartoon. Subject: pelican lung solidified liver-heavy, hepatization zones visible. Mood: heavy infection.

cards.power: The Sand-Lung. Breathing Rock-Dust turns soft lungs into hard, scarred stone.
cards.lore: Macro-Maggies eat the dust but die, calling Fibro-Fiona to build a permanent scar-tomb.
cards.gradeReason: Rock-Dust turns lungs to stone. Perfect name-power match, instantly performative.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: industrial hazard cartoon. Subject: bat lungs turning stone-hard with whorled collagen nodules. Mood: petrification.

cards.power: The Clogged-Filter. Inflames the Glomerulus-Grit until blood leaks and the Pressure-Alarm sounds.
cards.lore: Post-Strep Nate is a Type III War. Immune-Complexes riot in the filter.
cards.gradeReason: Clogged-Filter with RBC-cast leaks. Type III war needs glomerular setup to fully perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: glomerulonephritis cartoon. Subject: beaver dam blocking kidney filter, blood leaking through. Mood: pressure alarm.

cards.power: The Sieve-Leak. Filter is so broken that all the Albumin-Gold drains out, causing whole swelling.
cards.lore: MCD-Molly (Minimal Change Disease) attacks junior wrestlers, erasing the Podocyte-Feet.
cards.gradeReason: Albumin-Gold drains from broken filter, swelling entire body. Podocyte-Feet lore is gold.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: protein drain cartoon. Subject: swollen raccoon with albumin coins flooding out of kidney. Mood: golden loss.

cards.power: The Pipe-Melt. Renal-Pipes die and fall apart, clogging the system with Muddy-Debris.
cards.lore: Most common cause of Acute Renal Failure. If the host survives, pipes can regrow.
cards.gradeReason: Pipe-Melt clogs with Muddy-Debris. Mechanism clear, performance moderate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: tubular necrosis cartoon. Subject: fox amid muddy collapsed pipe cave-in, debris everywhere. Mood: acute crisis.

cards.power: The Yellow-Invasion. A bright yellow tumor that loves to grow into the vein and travel to the heart.
cards.lore: Clear Cells are full of lipids. Ray is a Vascular-Master who builds his own blood supply.
cards.gradeReason: Yellow-Invasion into renal vein, travelling to heart. Vascular conquest is vivid theater.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: vascular tumor cartoon. Subject: golden crab extending claws into renal vein toward heart. Mood: vascular conquest.

cards.power: The Pink-and-Blue Vision. Provides the Standard-Map of Punk-Villain-Battlefield.
cards.lore: Blue means Acid-Lover (DNA/RNA); Pink means Base-Lover (Cytoplasm).
cards.gradeReason: Pink-and-Blue Standard Map. Holly is a tool for the pathologist, not a combatant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: staining cartoon. Subject: chameleon painting nuclei blue and cytoplasm pink on tissue slide. Mood: diagnostic clarity.

cards.power: The Glycogen-Glow. Highlights everything sugar: Basement Membranes, Fungal Punks, Sugar-Stores.
cards.lore: A thick Basement Membrane glows as a solid, unmistakable bright magenta line.
cards.gradeReason: Glycogen-Glow in magenta. Highlights membranes and fungi. More technique than persona.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: magenta glow cartoon. Subject: pink microscope beam lighting up basement membranes and fungi. Mood: sweet revelation.

cards.power: The Rust-Finder. Turns hidden Iron-Stores (Hemosiderin) bright blue.
cards.lore: Used to find where Hank-Hemorrhage was hiding or to catch iron-overload.
cards.gradeReason: Rust-Finder turns iron bright blue. Detective role is clear but procedural.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: rust-detection cartoon. Subject: bloodhound painting hemosiderin deposits vivid bright blue. Mood: iron detective.

cards.power: The Identity-Tag. Uses Special-Key-Antibodies to unlock the true name of an Anaplastic tumor.
cards.lore: CD20+ = B-Cell-Brawler. CK7+ = Epithelial-Elite. Isaac never guesses; he proves it.
cards.gradeReason: Identity-Tag antibody key. Isaac never guesses — strong lore, still a technique card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: identity cartoon. Subject: detective dog holding antibody key to anaplastic tumor name. Mood: precision proof.

cards.power: The Total-Access. Opens the Body-Box to expose all the organ-tenants.
cards.lore: The very first step of the Sectio-Session. Everything starts with Yoda.
cards.gradeReason: Opens the Body-Box shoulder to pubis. Everything starts with Yoda — theatrical opening.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: autopsy cartoon. Subject: wise sage figure making Y-incision across ribcage. Mood: solemn total access.

cards.power: The Block-Lift. Removes all the tenants in one connected package.
cards.lore: Preserves the Connections to see if a Bile-Bandit escaped into the blood.
cards.gradeReason: Block-Lift of all tenants in one move. Specialized autopsy technique, procedural G2.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: en-bloc autopsy cartoon. Subject: gorilla lifting entire organ block in one connected piece. Mood: systematic.

cards.power: The Detail-Cut. Takes organs out one-by-one and slices them to find Hidden-Scars.
cards.lore: The Old-School way. Perfect for hunting tiny pneumonias deep in the lung.
cards.gradeReason: Old-School organ-by-organ dissection. Classic method, procedural and clear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: old-school autopsy cartoon. Subject: praying mantis slicing organs methodically one by one. Mood: precise tradition.

cards.power: The Ghost-Hunter. Finds the Chemical-Saboteurs the eyes can't see.
cards.lore: Vitreous-Humor is the ultimate vault for sugar or alcohol — it stays clean the longest.
cards.gradeReason: Ghost-Hunter for chemical saboteurs. Vitreous-Humor vault detail is sharp, instantly playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: toxicology cartoon. Subject: raccoon sifting vitreous humor for invisible chemical ghosts. Mood: ghost hunting.

cards.power: The Morphological-Oracle. The eyes see what the mind knows.
cards.lore: Inflammation, infarction, or infection? Show me the Basement membrane!
cards.gradeReason: Morphological-Oracle who sees what the mind knows. Meta-card, not a fighter.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: FrizzleBob oracle cartoon. Subject: rabbit pathologist with glowing microscope oracle eye. Mood: morphological authority.

cards.power: The Backwards Flow.
cards.lore: Identify the Pump-Failer (Cardio-Carl) and explain why the liver looks like a spice.
cards.gradeReason: Quiz card — identify nutmeg liver scenario. No character to embody, only to explain.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: quiz card. Subject: nutmeg liver, fibrin sheep, wet lung in diagnostic triad. Mood: diagnostic challenge.

cards.power: The Plaque-Pressure.
cards.lore: Explain the connection between the Pipe-Gunk and the Brain-Bleed in a Berry-Annie burst.
cards.gradeReason: Quiz card — explain plaque-to-aneurysm connection. Pedagogical, not performative.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: quiz card. Subject: arterial plaque leading to brain aneurysm burst, connected diagram. Mood: anatomical consequence.

cards.power: The Melted Feet.
cards.lore: Identify the syndrome and name the character responsible for erasing the Podocyte-Feet.
cards.gradeReason: Quiz card — identify nephrotic syndrome character. Learning exercise, no performance invite.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: quiz card. Subject: swollen raccoon with erased podocyte feet, Nelly as answer. Mood: clinical synthesis.

verdict: MedKayfab Pathology is FrizzleBob's most forensically precise deck to date — 56 cards spanning cell death, neoplasia, post-mortem changes, organ damage, special stains, and autopsy technique, all voiced with consistent wrestling-character energy. The cell death opener (Apoptosis-Arnie vs Necrosis-Nick) is G1 perfection: clean-exit versus toxic-explosion is immediately playable at any table. Weakness: the three Synthesis Quest cards at the end are learning exercises, not fighters — they break the performative contract and require facilitation. The forensic medicine section (post-mortem quartet plus cause-of-death sextet) is a deck within the deck, excellent for pathology and forensic medicine workshops. Table-ready: YES — with a note that the Synthesis Quests function better as discussion prompts than role-play cards.
blurb: For medical students who need pathology to actually stick: 56 characters who ARE the disease, from quiet Apoptosis-Arnie to Saddle-Embolus blocking the Lung-Highway and ending the match instantly.

notes: 15 pages (1 cover + 14 card pages), 4 cards per page, numbered 1-56. Cards are explicitly numbered within the PDF. Deck spans six thematic sections: (1) cell death and adaptation 1-4, (2) inflammation and repair 5-8, (3) neoplasia 9-12, (4) forensic post-mortem 13-16, (5) forensic cause-of-death 17-24, (6) organ pathology by system 25-44, (7) special stains and autopsy technique 45-52, (8) synthesis and meta 53-56. The three Synthesis Quest cards (54-56) are quiz exercises embedded in the deck using character references from earlier cards — pedagogically smart but break the performative standard. No RAF dice boxes visible; standard MedKayfab ADD format with STAT/POWER/LORE structure.

Algor-the-Cold could use a stronger character hook beyond the temperature formula

The staining section (45-48) would benefit from a Stain-Off Battle combo card

marketingText:
MedKayfab: PATHOLOGY & FORENSIC MEDICINE – Read the Body, Name the Cause (Medical Mnemonics Cut & Play Comic)

56 illustrated medical mnemonic cards to master how cells die, how tumours spread, and how a body tells you exactly what killed it.

Every other specialty interrogates a living patient who can lie, flinch, or get better overnight. Pathology gets the one witness that does none of that. A cell that committed quiet suicide at three in the morning, a clot that travelled from a calf vein to a pulmonary artery, a scatter of pinpoint haemorrhages that says asphyxia and not heart failure: the tissue keeps the whole record, and the entire discipline is the skill of reading it after the fact.

MedKayfab Pathology and Forensic Medicine turns dead tissue into a roster of characters, each mode of cell death, each tumour, and each cause of death wearing a face and a tell. Stop memorizing necrosis subtypes and post-mortem timelines as separate cold lists. Start performing the autopsy.

YOU'LL GET
- 56 illustrated MedKayfab cards (15pp, 4 cards/page)
- Full MedKayfab Freestyle rules (Quest Die mechanics)
- S-Tier characters like Apoptosis-Arnie, Metastasis-Mitch, and Cyanide-Cy
- Free lifetime updates as classifications and guidelines evolve
- CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence
- PDF optimized for home printing (A4 / Letter)

What's in the deck
The roster runs from the single cell up to the courtroom. Apoptosis-Arnie, the Clean Exit, is programmed cell death that folds a spent cell into a tidy package and slips it away before the immune system ever notices, the polite opposite of the messy necrotic brawl in the next section. Metastasis-Mitch, the Traveler, is the tumour cell that stops respecting its own border, packs a bag, and seeds itself in organs that never invited it. Cyanide-Cy, the Bitter Almond, jams cellular respiration shut so the blood stays bright red while the tissue suffocates, and Saddle-Embolus straddles the fork of the pulmonary artery to end the match in a single move. By the forensic chapters you stop asking what is wrong with the patient. You start asking who, and when, and how.

How it works
Every card is a cognitive anchor. You get the Character (the mnemonic), the Visual (the scene), the Stat Block (the defining numbers and findings), the Lore (the clinical and forensic story), and the Quest (the reasoning challenge). The Mechanism Flash mode is unforgiving here: if you cannot name the mode of cell death or the cause of death in one sentence without looking, the body on the Stage keeps its secret and the case goes cold.

Honest cognitive load
This is a core engine for medical students grinding through general pathology, anyone with an autopsy or forensic rotation ahead, and board candidates who keep blanking on the difference between coagulative and liquefactive necrosis under pressure. It pairs naturally with Histology and Microanatomy, the slide-level prequel to every diagnosis in here, and with the Immunology and Pathology deck for the inflammatory machinery behind the repair section.

ABOUT MEDKAYFAB
MedKayfab is a narrative medical learning card game, 50 decks covering the full medical curriculum. Every card encodes a clinical mechanism as a character with a personality, a story, and a reasoning challenge. Built by a physician. Assembled with AI tools. Manually revised.
